text:
Plan Meridian's 24 modules using final values only (drafts withdrawn).

Fixed: tenant/checkout:timeout_s=70; pricing:timeout_s=120,queue_depth=250; indexer:timeout_s=55; backup:timeout_s=110; shipping:timeout_s=30,ttl_s=450; export:ttl_s=480; media:ttl_s=600; archive:batch_size=900; ledger:max_workers=16; audit:max_workers=8; inventory:queue_depth=490; billing:queue_depth=270; reports:retry_limit=8.

Conditional (all triggered): backup.timeout_s>100→indexer.batch_size≤200; tenant.timeout_s>60→profile.ttl_s≥540; shipping.timeout_s>15→gateway.max_workers≥28; indexer.timeout_s>45→profile.batch_size≥900; export.ttl_s>450→media.queue_depth≤10; billing.queue_depth>240→tenant.retry_limit≤2; pricing.timeout_s>105→auth.ttl_s≤60; shipping.ttl_s>420→sync.queue_depth≥480.

Owners (exclusive): alpha: tenant,indexer; gamma: webhooks,search; beta: billing; delta: profile,reports,notify.

Same worker: tenant+checkout, billing+media, backup+quota, inventory+shipping. Apart: backup/media, auth/cache, alerts/archive, indexer/shipping.

Dependencies: auth→search,shipping; tenant→archive; billing→inventory; webhooks→media; notify→audit; gateway→search; profile→inventory. No path, direct or transitive: reports/notify, quota/gateway, archive/sync, indexer/auth.

Order: alerts before webhooks; billing before tenant; audit before sync; gateway before cache.

Files: rules.py→sync; bench.py→media; specs.py→inventory; guard.py,flags.py→audit; client.py→quota; forms.py→webhooks; views.py→reports.

Rest: team judgment. Output: work plan.
